title: Sweep: ledger binding runid (8 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Ledger binding and run-scoping prescriptions: run_id stamping, auditor binding, cross-run refusal. Amortised from 8 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.

prescriptions.text: PRESCRIPTION: Assert state-root identity in stateRoot (e.g. require .evolve/ledger.jsonl and .git under the resolved path) instead of trusting a non-empty EVOLVE_PROJECT_ROOT plus sibling presence

PRESCRIPTION: Invoke evolve acs suite from the project root, or pass an explicit output path: it resolves .evolve/runs/<cycle>/ relative to cwd, so a worktree cwd silently writes acs-verdict.json outside the workspace that ship and audit read.

PRESCRIPTION: Persist acs-verdict.json in the same transaction that emits the build handoff, or fail the audit-phase preflight by name when it is missing, instead of relying on the auditor re-running the suite
PRESCRIPTION: Generate the continuation-defect block delivered to Builder from the ancestor named in continuation-manifest.json so builder and auditor cannot disagree about inherited ids

PRESCRIPTION: Require the builder's ACS regression slice to persist its subprocess output to <workspace>/acs-verdict.json before the metric may be quoted in build-report.md; a sentinel evidence_path that does not resolve on disk must fail the build-to-audit gate.

PRESCRIPTION: Recompute the shipping-tree delta AFTER the build-to-audit transition reset and append it to build-report.md (or emit a shipping-delta.json sidecar), so the handoff narrative and the tree that ships are derived from the same bytes; today the reset at cycle-state.json phase_started_at re-parents the inherited continuation commit into the index after the builder has already written its report.

PRESCRIPTION: Fence lane rebases against a running audit phase (or re-bind audit_bound_tree_sha at gate time from cycle-state.json:active_worktree HEAD): the prior dispatch of this very cycle bound a tree that no ref carries once the rebase landed

PRESCRIPTION: Class fix: bind the audit to the tree that ships - the 21:42 pass stamped audit_bound_tree_sha 3e89a1c0 while the commit is tree 7ef291bb, so 4 files crossed the audit boundary unreviewed
